description: A quiet Markdown live preview editor that expands only the elements your cursor touches
config.previewColorScheme: Preview color scheme. With a VS Code high contrast theme, VS Code's colors are always used regardless of this setting.
config.colorCustomizations: Overrides the colors of individual elements. Write `"[green]": { ... }` to override only for that color (see the README).
config.fontFamily: Editor font. When empty, the VS Code editor font (`#editor.fontFamily#`) is used.
config.lineHeight: Line height as a multiple of the font size. Values below 1 follow `#editor.lineHeight#` (if that is also 0, 1.85 is used).
config.rightMargin: Adds a margin on the right side of the editor as wide as the one on the left.
